user_authorization.source: Direct user reply in this task authorizing the exact bounded scope in PR #503.
user_authorization.scope: One-time Crypto Core 100 fingerprint V0.2 baseline using the completed existing dataset, bounded R2 reads/writes stated in the merged PR #503 proposal, no provider requests, and no holdout, source switch, promotion, or trading.
user_authorization.scope_expansion: None; the separate actions:read permission below is limited to GitHub workflow-run metadata and enforces one dispatch.

authorized_scope.execution: Exactly one explicit workflow_dispatch of the existing weekly workflow after the authority and implementation are merged to main.

r2_reads.purpose: Resolve exact catalog key and SHA-256
Require COMPLETE state and exact shard bindings

r2_reads.condition: Only the catalog object referenced by the validated latest pointer
Only the 10 receipt keys referenced by the validated complete backfill state
Only partition keys referenced by those validated receipts; maximum expected 14274 objects

r2_reads.purpose: Require no prior V0.2 baseline; if present, stop. Do not read or reuse the V0.1 latest pointer.
Fresh complete-pagination byte inventory for the existing 8000000000-byte FREE-ONLY hard stop; inspect key/size metadata only, no object payloads.

r2_writes.condition: One run only; immutable key equality and SHA-256 readback required.
Write last only after outputs are verified; preserve training/binance_usdm/crypto-core-v0.1/latest.json unchanged.

authorized_scope.v0_1_latest_pointer: Must not be read, reused, migrated, overwritten, or treated as V0.2 evidence.

one_time_guard.purpose: Consume this one-time authorization on at most one workflow_dispatch run, including a run that fails before writing outputs.
one_time_guard.method: Use the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN with actions:read to paginate workflow-run metadata for this exact workflow and event; require exactly one run whose display_title starts with CORE100_V02_BOOTSTRAP and require its run_id equals GITHUB_RUN_ID.
one_time_guard.duplicate_or_incomplete_history: REVIEW_REQUIRED; stop before R2 access and training.
one_time_guard.permission_scope: actions:read only; no workflow mutation, dispatch, log, artifact, secret, or repository-content access.

rollback_and_failure: On any missing evidence, permission error, API pagination gap, duplicate dispatch, source drift, headroom >=8000000000 bytes, object collision, equality mismatch, SHA readback mismatch, or test/quality failure: stop; do not train further, write pointer, expand scope, or retry using another run.
